title: Counterexamples regarding elementary symmetric partitions
summary: Ballantine, Beck, and Merca defined the elementary symmetric partition map pre$_j$ that sends a partition $λ$ to a larger partition whose parts are the summands appearing in the evaluation of the $j$-th elementary symmetric polynomial on $λ$. They conjectured that pre$_j$ is injective on the set of partitions of $n$ with length $\ell \geq j$. The $\ell = j$ case was disproved by Devnani and Eyyunni; they instead conjectured the statement to be true for $\ell > j$. In this article, we answer this refined conjecture in the negative by proving that pre$_j$ is not injective on partitions of $n$…
